gloss: to cultivate; to foster; to nurture

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {培|つちか}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to cultivate; to foster; to nurture
definitions.explanation: to develop or nurture qualities, skills, or relationships over time

examples.japanese: ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{培|つちか}う。
⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{培|つちか}ってきた⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are skills cultivated over many years.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{感性|かんせい}→感性：12628_kansei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{培|つちか}うこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to nurture children's sensitivity.

notes:
{培|つちか}う means to develop something gradually over time, typically abstract qualities.

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (う-verb)
- Transitive

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧ (soil) + ⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧ (to raise)
- Originally meant agricultural cultivation
- Now primarily figurative

WRITING:
- Uses {培|つちか}う (cultivate)
- Related to ⟦{栽培|さいばい}→栽培：13108_saibai⟧ (cultivation)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{培|つちか}う (cultivate trust)
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{培|つちか}う (cultivate skills)
- ⟦{感性|かんせい}→感性：12628_kansei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{培|つちか}う (nurture sensitivity)
- ⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{培|つちか}う (foster friendship)
- ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{培|つちか}う (nurture relationships)
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{培|つちか}う (develop ability)

USAGE:
- Almost always used figuratively
- Implies gradual, patient development
- Positive connotation
- Often used with ～てきた to emphasize the process over time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧ (to raise, grow)
- ⟦{養|やしな}う→養う：04478_yashinau⟧ (to nurture, support)
- ⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧ (to polish, refine)

DIFFERENCE FROM SIMILAR VERBS:
- {培|つちか}う: Emphasizes gradual development over time
- ⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: More general raising/growing
- ⟦{養|やしな}う→養う：04478_yashinau⟧: Includes sense of providing sustenance

REGISTER: Somewhat formal. Common in written Japanese and speeches.
